name: Shifter Feral Champion
body:
You are an untamed combatant, exclusively reliant upon the tools granted to you by nature. While you may have an animal -like form, many feral warriors are just humanoids that have rejected the trappings of civilization and have instead chosen to embrace their wild, primeval origins.

Outwardly primitive and seemingly savage, you literally claw and bite your way through encounters.

Unlike most shifters, you envisions yourself as part of the natural ecosystem rather than its caretaker. You treat the indigenous animals and beasts sharing your habitat as equals rather than subordinates. Despite this sentiment, you are still a child of the wilderness and a hunter at heart, living off the bounty of the land like your fellow predators, but tempered with the sensibilities and motivations appropriate to your intellect and alignment.

Wild At Heart

As a feral champion, you may be of any alignment.

This feature alters alignment requirements, and replaces bonus languages.

Feral Talents

At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, you gain a talent of your choice from the following list. You may also, optionally, choose to use any of your bonus feats at 6th, 12th, and 18th levels to select one of these talents.

Camouflage (Ex)

Select a single terrain from the ranger’s favored terrain list.

You are a master at hiding in that terrain, and while within that terrain, you can use the Stealth skill to hide, even while being observed. You must be at least 8th level to select this talent. You may select this talent more than once, each time selecting a different terrain from the ranger’s favored terrain list.

Careful Claw (Ex)

When using a natural weapon to attack a creature using fire shield or a similar effect that damages creatures attacking it (such as a barbed devil’s barbed defense), you reduce the damage from such effects by an amount equal to 1/2 your level. You must be at least 8th level to select this talent.

Feral Sense (Ex)

You gain the scent ability. In addition, you gain a bonus to Sense Motive checks equal to 1/2 your level against living creatures that you can smell.

Rage Power

You gain a barbarian rage power, using your shifter level as your effective barbarian level. You must meet all of the prerequisites listed for the rage power selected, and you cannot select a rage power that modifies a class feature you do not possess. If you choose a rage power that normally requires you to be raging, it instead applies whenever you shift into a minor form. You may select this talent more than once; each time, you gain a new rage power.

Treat Wounds (Ex)

You have learned how to use a variety of quick, natural remedies to stop bleeding, alleviate pain, and stave off infection. During the course of a single day, you can utilize this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day for every four levels gained beyond 4th, to a maximum of 5 times per day at 20th level. You may use the ability on your own wounds or the wounds of another creature you can touch. Each use of treat wounds is a standard action that provokes attacks of opportunity. The amount of hit points healed is equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom bonus (minimum 1), increasing by 1d8 at 8th level and every four levels thereafter.

Vigilante Talent: You gain a vigilante talent of your choice, treating your shifter level as your effective vigilante level. You cannot select a vigilante talent that modifies a class feature you do not possess. For the purpose of these talents, you are considered to be in your vigilante identity whenever you shift into a minor form. You may select this talent more than once; each time, you gain a new vigilante talent.

Weathered (Ex)

Constant exposure to the ravages of the elements enables you to withstand the debilitating effects of heat and cold. As a result, you can exist comfortably in conditions between –50 and 140 degrees Fahrenheit without having to make Fortitude saves, as if affected by a constant, non-magical endure elements effect. Unlike the spell, this effect does not extend to your equipment. In addition, you gain cold resistance and fire resistance in an amount equal to your class level.

This feature replaces wild shape, a thousand faces, and timeless body.

Character Options: The Vigilante. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
